The activity commenced with a warm welcome from the BAPTC – Project Management Personnel followed by a tour around the Center, where they witnessed the different vegetable trading activities. 

Afterwards, the TOD and IDESU, headed by Ms. Octavia S. Ablos, provided the delegates with an overview of the milestones, practices and services of the Center. This was followed by an open forum where inquiries from the visitors were accommodated. 

The activity concluded with a photo op with the delegates.
